name: Quantum Motion
description: Quantum Motion is a UK quantum computing company developing silicon-based quantum processors using industry-standard 300mm CMOS fabrication technology. Founded by researchers from UCL and the University of Oxford, the company delivered the first full-stack silicon CMOS quantum computer to the UK National Quantum Computing Centre and was advanced to DARPA QBI Stage B in 2025.

products.name: Silicon CMOS Quantum Processor
products.description: Quantum computing processors fabricated on industry-standard 300mm CMOS silicon technology for scalable qubit architectures

highlights: Delivered the first full-stack silicon CMOS quantum computer to the UK National Quantum Computing Centre
Advanced to DARPA Quantum Benchmarking Initiative Stage B in 2025
Raised USD 160M Series C in May 2026 co-led by DCVC and Kembara, positioning it as the UK's best-funded quantum company

news.title: Quantum Motion raises USD 160M Series C to scale silicon spin qubit processors
news.excerpt: The round, co-led by DCVC and Kembara with participation from the British Business Bank, Firgun, Bosch Ventures, Porsche SE, and returning investors, makes Quantum Motion the UK's best-funded quantum company. Funds will scale the 300mm CMOS silicon spin qubit platform toward utility-scale commercial deployment.
